payload.title: A description follows its image across channels until it is changed on its own
payload.context: Images review (#25): one owner posts the same photos to four Pages, and descriptions had to be typed and kept in step in every column.
payload.rationale: Alt text stays per attachment, because it is approved content. The editor fills the same image's description in other columns while theirs is empty or identical, and offers to bring them back in step. Order stays per channel with an explicit action to copy it.
payload.consequences: The behaviour lives in the page and has no automated test, since there is no frontend test harness.
